proof_body:
by
  intro K _ f g hg
  refine ⟨(f / g, f % g), ⟨(EuclideanDomain.div_add_mod f g).symm, Polynomial.degree_mod_lt f hg⟩, ?_⟩
  rintro ⟨q, r⟩ ⟨h, hr⟩
  have hd : g * (q - f / g) = f % g - r := by
    have h' := EuclideanDomain.div_add_mod f g
    simp only at h
    linear_combination -h - h'
  have hq : q - f / g = 0 := by
    by_contra hne
    have h1 : g.degree ≤ (g * (q - f / g)).degree := by
      rw [Polynomial.degree_mul]
      exact le_add_of_nonneg_right (Polynomial.zero_le_degree_iff.mpr hne)
    rw [hd] at h1
    have h2 : (f % g - r).degree < g.degree := lt_of_le_of_lt (Polynomial.degree_sub_le _ _) (max_lt (Polynomial.degree_mod_lt f hg) hr)
    exact absurd h1 (not_le.mpr h2)
  have hq' : q = f / g := sub_eq_zero.mp hq
  rw [hq, mul_zero] at hd
  have hr' : r = f % g := (sub_eq_zero.mp hd.symm).symm
  simp [hq', hr']
target_source: ∀ (K : Type*) [Field K] (f g : Polynomial K), g ≠ 0 → ∃! p : Polynomial K × Polynomial K, f = g * p.1 + p.2 ∧ p.2.degree < g.degree
